understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to solve each level by positioning the available movable/selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile (marked with a '+') is occupied by a piece at the same time, which triggers WIN and advances through all levels until the final win condition is reached.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumed a limited step budget per level. A piece could be moved either by directional commands (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) or by clicking a target cell; a CLICK would attempt to move the currently selected piece toward/onto that cell if the path/rules allowed it. Pieces could not pass through walls/obstacles, and attempted moves that were blocked had no effect but still spent a step. Selection determined which piece would respond to actions (typically by clicking a piece/cell), and success required coordinating multiple pieces so all '+' tiles were covered simultaneously.
